subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Islanding: When Parts Break Away
description: Learn Islanding: When Parts Break Away in one minute.

hook.text: If a section of grid disconnects, it becomes an electrical island. That can be deadly.

buildup.text: An island must balance its own generation and load instantly or frequency collapses.

discovery.text: Anti-islanding protection shuts down solar inverters if grid voltage disappears.

twist.text: Microgrids intentionally island themselves during outages to keep critical loads running.

climax.text: Planned islanding with batteries and solar kept hospitals lit after hurricanes.

punchline.text: Unplanned islands are dangerous. Planned ones save lives.

quiz.question: Why is unplanned islanding dangerous?
options: It sends power backward through transformers
The isolated section can't balance generation and demand, causing instability
It always causes fires at the disconnection point
